meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将任意文本变成配图解的解说视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想不露脸就把文字稿变成解说视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn any text into a faceless explainer video with generated graphics
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn articles or notes into explainer videos without filming anything.

howto.what: 你给它一篇文章、笔记或主题，它会把它做成一个无人出镜的解说视频：先规划叙事脚本，配上画外音，再逐帧生成排版、图形、图表等画面，最后渲染成 MP4 文件。
howto.when: 当你把一段文字（文章、笔记、主题等）交给它并要求做成解说视频时触发，适用于主题讲解、概念拆解、操作指南等解说类内容。

say.text: 把这篇文章做成一个无脸解说视频。
say.note: 它会创建项目并开始规划故事板和脚本。

say.text: 用这段笔记做一条60秒的概念拆解。
say.note: 时长会影响脚本和帧数安排。
它会选择男性旁白声音。

howto.what_en: Turns supplied text into a faceless explainer video: sets up a project, plans a storyboard/script, generates voiceover and BGM, builds frames with invented visuals, and renders an MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user provides text (e.g., an article, notes, a topic) and asks for an explainer video. Intended for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, and similar; not for website-based product videos.

say_en.text: Turn this article into a faceless explainer video.
say_en.note: It creates a project and starts planning.

say_en.text: Make a 60-second concept breakdown from these notes.
say_en.note: Duration shapes script and frame count.

say_en.text: Use a male voice for the narration.
say_en.note: It selects a male voice for TTS.
